sentences.text: Code. (G.R. Case No.99 Of 2024) vs In Re: Isu Ali @ Md. Isha on

In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section 48
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed on 29.01.2025
 connection with Ranitala Police Station Case No.708 of 2024 
 22.09.2024 under Sections 498A/304B/306/34 of the Indian Pen
 Code. (G.R. Case No.99 of 2024)
 And
 In Re: Isu Ali @ Md. Isha
 ... ... 
 Mr. Mobaidur Hossain
 ... ... for the petiti
 Mr. Pravas Bhattacharya
 Mr. Soumyadip Saha
 ... ... for the State
 1.
Heard learned Advocates for both the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the uncle-in-law of the victim wife.
Allegations against him are general and omnibus.
Incident occurred six years after marriage.
Under such circumstances, we are of the opinion custodial interrogation of the petitioner for progress of investigation is not necessary and he may be granted anticipatory bail.

3. Accordingly, we direct in the event of arrest, the accused/petitioner, namely, Isu Ali @ Md. Isha,
be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
Signed By : ARUP KUMAR DAS High Court of Calcutta 11 th of February 2025 04:12:40 PM 4.
The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, disposed of.
